title: Head EM Credit Trading EMEA (D or MD)
full_description:
London, United Kingdom
Department Overview:Global Credit Trading team (“GCT”) is responsible for credit trading in Emerging Europe, Asia and European IG, Covered Bonds, HY and US IG. The group is an active market maker in hard currency credit and supports primary bond activity. Flow trading, credit analysis, pricing, structuring, execution, hedging, electronic/voice trading and distribution are key components of the business. The team interact daily with Sales, Research and DCM/Syndicate.
GCT aims to be at the front of the ongoing transformation in financial markets aided by data analytics and systematic trading. Successful candidates will be change leaders, with ambition to improve performance through the adoption of technology.
Main Duties and Responsibilities of Role:GCT operates in a high paced environment and is looking for a candidate who can learn quickly and adapt to this fluid environment. The candidate will head the EM Credit Trading desk EMEA within GCT heading a 5 member team trading overall Emerging Markets in London and interact regularly with Sales, Syndicate, Research and Risk Management functions. Main markets are CEE, MENA, ex CIS, Turkey South Africa. It is essential  that the candidate has a solid track record in trading Emerging Markets CEEMEA risk as he/she is expected to trade and provide leadership to this team.
Make markets competitively and consistently in Emerging Markets hard currency cash products to the firm’s clients with the objective of producing stable sustainable revenue across the credit cycle.
